purpose: Editor-only local projected aerial layout previews; generic provisional district names, not narrative canon

prompts.Farm: Create a square 1024px aerial layout preview image for a rural Unreal game village blockout, camera perfectly vertical orthographic straight down, no perspective, no horizon, no labels, no text, no borders, no arrows, no UI, no watermark. This will be projected as a square local decal on terrain as a rough placement guide. Show recognizable coarse facility and building footprints from roof view, muted earthy colors, lightly photographic miniature aerial imagery, very soft shadows, uniform daylight. Entire square is one district, ground continues to all image edges. Leave generous empty dirt/grass around the facility footprints. Do not draw paths going out of the square, roads connecting other districts, railway, people, or vehicles. Farm district: three modest sheds with weathered gray and brown roofs, six large rectangular vegetable plots, compact orchard rows, small open farm yard and a few stacks of hay, mostly grassy soil. Few large readable elements.
